_doc: Every external or generated asset gets one entry here, so it can be re-fetched or regenerated without touching code. Run tools/fetch_assets.py to download what is missing, tools/gen_decals.sh to regenerate the procedural ones and tools/build_sounds.py to cut the sounds. tools/gen_foliage.sh draws what has source "drawn". A model names the surface a shot finds on it (wood, concrete or soft) when that is not metal.

firearms.title: The Free Firearm Sound Library, prepared shots
firearms.author: Still North Media

the rifle: an AK-47 from close by, over the low end of an SKS at mid distance and a thump
the pistol: a Walther PPQ in 9 mm, over the low end of a 1911 and a thump

the shotgun: a Benelli Nova and a Mossberg, 12 gauge, from close by with the blast left in, thickened with the body of a Winchester Model 12, over the Nova at mid distance with the echo it has there, a deep thump and a rumble that rolls on
the SMG: a PPSh firing single rounds, over its own low end at mid distance and a thump

the marksman rifle: a Mosin Nagant from close by with its crack left in, over the same shot at mid distance with the echo it has there, a second echo, its low end, a thump and a rumble that rolls on for two seconds
a robot firing: a Carl Gustav M45 at mid distance, over its low end from close by and a thump
the player coming down from a jump
a shot landing on concrete or brick
a shot landing on bags, tyres and cardboard
a shot landing in somebody: a burst of noise that is white for an instant and brown before it has died away. Chosen by ear over a punch with a crunch of snow under it, which sounded like neither
the wreck of a barrel coming down
a grenade bouncing: heavy metal coming down on something hard
barrels, gas bottles, jerrycans and grenades going off: a rumble with the bang of a shotgun at its front
a robot blowing apart: a low boom with steel plate and metal coming down in it
the flame out of a holed barrel or gas bottle
somebody who is hit: a short grunt, of three men
somebody who has seen the player: a shout, of four men
somebody going down: a groan rather than a scream, of four men
somebody who has lost his head and runs about: the long screams, of three men, at their full length; split only takes the silence off either end
the steps of an enemy who is a person: boots on concrete, a little duller than the player's own
somebody who was shot coming down on the floor
an enemy who is a person striking out
a shot the plate on a grunt's arm stops
the plate shot off a grunt's arm: a heavy blow on steel plate and metal coming down

a hanging lamp or a floodlight shot out: glass breaking, slowed down to make it a bigger pane, over a blow on sheet metal for the shade, something thicker breaking, a heavy knock on glass and a thump for body, with shards coming down a quarter of a second later and the last of them after half a second. No electric snap: there is no recording of one
a caged bulb or a fluorescent tube shot out: a sharp tick, a short thump and a tap on glass for the pop, over a little glass breaking, sped up to make it thinner, and a last tinkle

a wooden crate shot apart: wood breaking or cracking, slowed down, over a knock on wood and two deep blows for its weight, more wood breaking for the splinters, boards coming down from a quarter of a second on and one landing after them

a cardboard box bursting. There is no recording of cardboard: this is the nearest thing, a dry rustling burst of some loose material with its top taken off, over a light knock, a dull blow and a step in snow for the crumpling

wooden crates dropping onto what is left of the stack under them: a heavy blow on a plank over wood slamming shut and a deep thump, with boards rattling after it and a second, duller blow as they settle
a can of ammunition picked up: loose metal rattling
a cell picked up: a click
a grenade picked up: a clunk of heavy metal
a spent case landing on the floor and ringing: small bright metal that falls
the shell of the shotgun landing on the floor: duller than a case of brass
the pin of a grenade pulled and the lever springing off: a spring, with keys over it for the ring
the arm that throws a grenade: a heavy swish, slowed down
the magazine dropping out of the pistol
a magazine going into the pistol
the slide of the pistol being racked
the magazine coming out of a rifle or the SMG: that of the pistol, slowed down to make it a bigger one
a magazine going into a rifle or the SMG: that of the pistol, slowed down
the bolt of a rifle or the SMG going home: the slide of the pistol, slowed down
the bolt of the marksman rifle: a bolt action rifle being cocked
a shell being pushed into the shotgun
the pump of the shotgun, back and forward, after a shot and when it is loaded
the hammer falling on an empty chamber: a sharp click, with a duller knock and a short thump under it for the steel it falls on
one weapon put away and the next brought up, and a weapon lowered to be reloaded: the click of dry_fire as the one comes loose, and a tenth of a second later the clunk of the other seating

the player going down into a slide: there is no recording of somebody sliding over concrete. This is a step in snow played slow for the grit under a boot, a rustle after it, the thud of a hip on the floor and a sleeve, with noise under them for as long as the slide lasts

assets.use: a round that misses and goes by close: a recording of bullets going by, Bullet Fly By from Freesound, of which the four short ones are used as they are. Michiel fetched it himself: Freesound asks for an account
a zombie that has seen the player: the growls of middling length out of a pack of zombie voices, a little slower for a larger throat
a zombie that is hit: the short ones
a zombie going down: the long ones, sinking a little as they go
a clown who has seen the player: the first second and a bit of a laugh, played a fifth faster, which makes it a smaller and shriller man
a clown who is hit: a yelp, a man's grunt played a third faster
a clown going down: a wail that runs down like a toy whose spring is spent
a clown who has lost his head and runs about: the long screams, shriller and shaking
a robot that has seen the player: it says so, target acquired or target found, in the voice of a machine, pushed into a clip so that it carries, with a blip in front
a robot that goes round the player because it cannot see him: target out of sight, or where did you go
a robot that runs from something: taking cover, or I need backup, under three blips of alarm
a robot winding up before a burst: an engine and a hum that rise in pitch for as long as the warning lasts
a heavy winding up: a large engine rising, with something big charging under it
a rusher winding up: the same, small and quick
the door of the exit rolling up: the door of an old lift sliding, slowed down to make it a heavier one, with a ratchet as it comes loose, slats and a chain rattling over it and a motor under it

what a hall sounds like when nothing happens: a recording of a large space with plant in it, a drone and a machine a long way off, and under them the air that is moved through it and the hum of what hangs from its roof
the same for a room or a corridor: the building around it through the walls, air and the tube lights
the same under the open sky: a recording of wind, twice and at two speeds so that it does not come round the same, gusts over it and the works beyond the wall
the same for a boiler house: water on the boil, the burners roaring, a pump and steam escaping somewhere
the same for a turbine hall: a machine humming and one running, the sets turning under them, their whirr over it, the tone of what they generate and the floor carrying all of it
something in a hall now and then: metal that is knocked, shut or let go, somewhere
something in a boiler house now and then: a valve letting off steam, which is what it is a recording of
something in a turbine hall now and then: a contactor dropping in
something on a yard now and then: metal coming down somewhere behind the sheds
the player's steps on sand: a dull crunch that gives, where concrete claps
a shot landing in sand: a thump, and the hiss of what it throws up
the dunes by day: wind over open sand, and in the pines a hiss that comes and goes

a checkpoint reached: a deep breath in, and the start of letting it go. The recording is of somebody out of breath, whose breaths are a third of a second: one of them at a little over half speed is the breath of a larger chest, and backwards it swells and stops short, which is what breathing in does
blood on the floor or the wall behind somebody who is shot
